name: C: Synth arp – D&B energy
description: A fast supersaw arp climbing and descending through each chord — classic drum & bass feel. The filter slowly opens and closes so it keeps evolving. More electronic and high-energy than the others.

roles.name: Snare
roles.groove: mask "<f!4 t!12>" $ s "~ sn ~ sn" # gain 1 # shape 0.2

roles.name: Chopped break
roles.groove: mask "<f!8 t!8>" $ s "amencutup*16" # n (irand 32) # gain 0.6 # hpf 1500

roles.name: Synth Arp
roles.fx: # lpf (range 1500 4500 $ slow 4 sine) # gain 0.45 # room 0.3 # delay 0.3 # delaytime (60/174*0.5) # delayfeedback 0.35
roles.groove: n (arp "updown" "<d'min bf'maj f'maj c'maj>") # s "supersaw" # lpf (range 1500 4500 $ slow 4 sine) # gain 0.45 # room 0.3 # delay 0.3 # delaytime (60/174*0.5) # delayfeedback 0.35
